title: Psalms 3
paragraphs: ¹ Lord, how many enemies I have! How many rise against me! ² Many say of me, "God won't rescue him." Selah. ³ But you, LORD, are a shield around me — my glory, the one who holds my head high. ⁴ I called out to the LORD, and he answered me from his holy mountain. Selah. ⁵ I lay down and slept; I woke up safely, because the LORD was sustaining me.

⁶ I will not fear the tens of thousands arrayed against me on every side. ⁷ Arise, LORD! Deliver me, my God! You have struck all my enemies on the jaw; you have broken the teeth of the wicked. ⁸ Salvation belongs to the LORD; may your blessing rest on your people. Selah.
